messages:
Sasha (growth): Quick idea thread 1: run a tiny PLG funnel experiment for new signups: 50 free credits + curated prompt pack + an optional 20-min workshop. Target metric: increase "first-10-requests" activation from ~12% to ~19%. Thoughts?

Arman (content): Love it. Recommend 2 persona-led packs: "Developer starter" and "Product templates". Keep sample prompts tiny. We'll need short landing copy and 3 tweet-length lines for social.

Priya (growth): Cohort: signed up <= 10 days, zero requests. Sequence: immediate credits, Day 2 prompt nudge + CTA, Day 4 webinar invite, Day 7 reminder. Cap 400 users for this run. A/B copy: explicit value vs generic.

Theo (analytics): I'll capture experiment_id and utm. Baseline: first-10 conv 12.1%, avg session tokens 430, retention7 10.2%. Set goals: +7pp conv, retention7 -> 13.5%. Will add event names: "grant_credit", "view_prompt_pack", "request_made".

Jules (events): I can host a 20-min "build with prompts" session next Wed 10am PT. 12-min demo + 8-min Q&A. Landing page + calendar link by Tue EOD. Need slides + 6 demo prompts Monday.

Arman (content): Draft prompt samples (short):
- Developer starter: "JS: validate email input and return JSON error with field and message."
- Product templates: "Write a 5-bullet spec for auto-summarizing meetings into action items."
- Outreach snippet: "3-line cold email to hire ML infra engineer, tone: concise, friendly."

Sasha (growth): We'll include a prompt pack preview inline on landing. Emails: two variants. Variant A: generic invite. Variant B: benefit-led "50 credits + ready-to-use prompts". Track conversions to activated(10 requests).

Priya (growth): I'll create cohorts in PostHog and set up the A/B test. Also add a mobile onboarding variant that surfaces the prompt pack modal on first session.

Theo (analytics): Dashboard: experiment funnel, cost-per-activation, tokens burned per activated. Will surface by Wed. Schema posted here: event list + properties.

playbook-bot: Playbook created -> micro-credits-workshop-promptpack (owner: Sasha).

Jules (events): I'll wire reminder emails at 24h and 1h before workshop. Also add an auto-join CTA in the product for registrants.

Sasha (growth): Action items: @Arman finalize copy & promo lines (Mon EOD), @Jules landing + calendar (Tue EOD), @Theo tracking + dashboard (Wed), @Priya cohort + experiment (Tue). Launch target: next Wed. Reconvene Monday after copy review. :thumbsup:

Arman (content): I'll post draft copy here by this afternoon. Keep it short for in-product banners and tweets.

Priya (growth): Noted. I'll limit credits to first 400 and add a guard to prevent gaming (one per account, require email verification).

Theo (analytics): Reminder: include session_id and experiment_id on all CTAs so we can dedupe.

Sasha (growth): Thanks team. We'll aim to ship assets and roll early cohorts next week.
